Definition: prolongation from G2409; to be a priest, i.e. perform his functions:--execute the priest's office.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, hierateúō means to serve as a priest. It occurs just once, in Luke.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: hierateúō means to serve as a priest, and I do not stretch it further.
RelatedEvents: The Birth of John the Baptist
